resources.string: Early public app foundation. Network status, optional VPN permission preparation and a user-confirmed TLS-only gateway check. No VPN connection, forwarding or optimization is available.
Android has not validated this connection
Android validated this connection; speed and reachability are not guaranteed
No test app selected. No traffic is routed.
No other launcher apps are visible. Nothing was selected.
Selected for future testing: %1$s (%2$s). No traffic is routed.
VPN readiness not checked. No connection is started.
The selected test app is no longer launcher-visible. Select it again before requesting VPN permission. No VPN was started.
Select a test app first. No traffic is routed.
A VPN is visible to BetterNet. BetterNet will not disturb it.
An Internet-capable default network or complete VPN visibility is unavailable. No VPN was started.
Android did not allow the readiness check. No VPN was started.
No VPN was visible to BetterNet; Android VPN permission is still required. No VPN was started.
Android reports prior VPN preparation. This is not a connection; no VPN was started.
No restricted test path configured. No connection is started.

Only stage a test configuration in memory. No VPN permission, network request, or routing is started. Use an independently approved public test destination and a disposable gateway credential. The configuration is lost when this screen is recreated.
Approved numeric public IPv4 or IPv6
Invalid configuration. Check names, public numeric IP, port and credential format.
Staged only: %1$s:%2$d → %3$s (%4$s). No traffic is routed.

This asks Android for VPN permission only. BetterNet is still pre-alpha: it will NOT start a VPN, capture traffic, connect to a gateway, or use the staged credential. Android VPN permission is device-level and may remain granted after you clear the test app. If another VPN is active, cancel and keep using it.
A restricted VPN test is active

This makes one outbound DNS/TCP/TLS connection to the gateway you entered, on the current non-VPN network. It may use metered data. No bearer credential, CONNECT request, VPN or selected-app traffic is sent. A valid TLS handshake does not prove Internet forwarding.
Gateway TLS identity verified. No VPN or Internet forwarding was tested.
Gateway TLS check failed or network/app scope changed. No VPN was started.
Check authenticated HTTPS gateway path (no VPN)

This sends your disposable gateway credential over verified TLS to the gateway you entered, then sends one HTTPS HEAD request to the approved public IP and hostname through that gateway. It may use metered data. The gateway can observe the destination. No VPN or selected-app traffic is started. Only use a gateway and destination you control or are authorized to test. A response does not prove selected-app forwarding.
Verified HTTPS peer responded with HTTP %1$d via the gateway. No VPN or selected-app forwarding was tested.
Authenticated HTTPS path failed or authorization changed. No VPN was started.
